premises.text: Internet giants pay for global CDNs and large security teams for speed and safety, but ordinary websites lack access to those tools
premises.evidence_span: if you're trying to run a website today, you're left alone without access to any of these tools

premises.text: Cloudflare delivers performance and security via a globally distributed network with ~5-minute DNS nameserver setup—no hardware, software, or code changes; works with any stack
premises.evidence_span: all you do is make one change to your domain's name servers, and suddenly you're on the Cloudflare network

premises.text: Benefits include ~30% faster page loads, stopping spam/attacks, HTML rewrite/caching proxy with deep inspection, and one-click Google Analytics upgrades
premises.evidence_span: We deliver an average of a 30% decrease in page load times to your site when you sign up

premises.text: Service is free at the only sensible price point while already covering variable costs per user
premises.evidence_span: there's really only one price point for a service like ours, and that's free

value.text: Any website gets giant-class speed and security—make the web faster and safer
value.evidence_span: make the web a faster, safer place

causal_links.evidence_span: takes the tools of the biggest service providers and makes them available for anyone with a website online
Cloudflare's got your back, and we won't rest until your site is fast, safe, and secure
Even though we haven't charged a single user, We are already making money on each

notes: Speed and security concerns of giants folded into one access-gap problem for ordinary sites (§4.1.6). DNS onboarding, stack-agnostic network, speed/spam stop, GA button, and XSS demo folded as cascade of one Cloudflare network mechanism (§4.1.7).
